value.rationale: The motivator develops finite exact-value modal certificates with per-box height bound; a value-sensitive sharp boundary and width-based uniform optimum substantially improve this resource bound and clarify which successors are indispensable. The exact per-instance optimization/NP-hardness result supplies a concrete algorithmic boundary for extracting small witnesses. Even a chain with multiple truth values improves from height minus one witnesses per box to one. Standard lattice breadth itself is not claimed as a discovery.
